version.title: Nooca
version.description: Nooca temetro ee serverkan ku shaqaynaya, iyo haddii nooc cusub la heli karo.
version.updateDescription: temetro waa la iskiis u martigeliyaa Docker. Si aad u cusbooneysiiso, soo dejji sawirrada cusub oo dib u bilow mashiinka serverka.
version.networkDescription: U ogolow qaybaha kale inay temetro ka furaan kombuyuutarradooda shabakadda isbitaalka iyagoo isticmaalaya cinwaankan.
version.networkLocalHint: Waxaad temetro u daawanaysaa si maxalli ah. Si aad u wadaagto, ka fur app-ka mashiinka serverka adigoo isticmaalaya cinwaanka IP-ga shabakadda (tusaale ipconfig / ifconfig), ka dibna wadaag URL-kaas.
version.networkFirewallHint: Firewall-ka serverka waa inuu u ogolaadaa port-ka si qalabka kale ugu xiraan.
version.banner: Nooc cusub oo temetro ({{version}}) ayaa la heli karaa.

integrations.intro: Ku xir temetro nidaamyada caafimaadka ee dibadda. Ku tilmaam isku-xir kasta endpoint-ka sandbox ama wax-soo-saarka ee bixiyahaaga oo bixi aqoonsigiisa.
integrations.credentialsSet: •••••••• (la kaydiyay — qor si aad u beddesho)
integrations.enableHint: Marka la shido, ficilladiisa ayaa ka soo muuqda bogagga la xiriira.

fhir.description: Ka akhri natiijooyinka shaybaadhka server FHIR R4 ama HL7 v2 (tusaale HAPI FHIR / SMART Health IT sandbox, ama albaabka shaybaadhkaaga).
fhir.credentialsHint: Waxaa loo diraa Bearer token, ama JSON {"token":"…"}. U daa banaan sandbox-yada dadweynaha.

eprescribe.credentialsHint: JSON leh token-ka albaabkaaga iyo aqoonsiga diraha.

claims.title: Dalabaadka caymiska (X12 837/835)

claims.credentialsHint: JSON leh token-ka xarunta xisaabinta iyo aqoonsiyada diraha/qaataha.

fhirServer.title: Serfarka FHIR (la wadaag diiwaannadaada)
fhirServer.description: U soo bandhig diiwaannada rugtan nidaamyada dibadda ah sida serfar FHIR R4 akhris-oo-keliya, oo lagu ansixiyo furayaal API oo rug walba gaar u ah.
fhirServer.baseUrlHint: U tilmaam macmiil FHIR URL-kan. Wuxuu adeegaa Patient, Observation, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, MedicationRequest, Encounter iyo Appointment.
fhirServer.secretHint: Tanu waa markii kaliya ee sirta la muujiyo. Meel ammaan ah ku kaydi — lama soo ceshan karo dabadeed.
fhirServer.noKeys: Weli ma jiraan furayaal API ah. Mid samee si macmiil FHIR u xidho.

records.patientStorageDesc: Ka akhri oo ku qor diiwaannada si toos ah qalabka bukaanka marka app-ka wehelka ah la sii daayo.
records.importExportDescription: U dhaqaaji diiwaannada temetro gudaha iyo dibadda
records.exportDesc: Soo dejji diiwaan kasta oo bukaan oo rugtan ku jira sida hal kayd.
records.importDesc: Ku xir xog bukaan oo jirta oo ku daawo isla muuqaalka kaararka.
records.retentionBody: Diiwaannada waxaa la hayaa inta ay rugtaadu jirto. Tirtiridda bukaan si joogto ah ayaa looga saaraa diiwaankiisa xogta rugta, diiwaanka dhaqdhaqaaqana wuxuu hayaa raad hubin oo isbeddel kasta — cida sameysay iyo goorta.
records.exportDoneBody: Waxaa la soo dejiyay {{count}} diiwaan bukaan.
records.exportFailedBody: Diiwaannada lama dhoofin karin. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
records.importTemetroDesc: Ka soo rar bukaanno faylka dhoofinta temetro. Lambarrada faylka ee jira waa la boodhayaa.
records.importPreview: {{count}} diiwaan bukaan oo diyaar u ah soo dejinta.
records.importFailedBody: Diiwaannada lama soo dejin karin. Fadlan isku day mar kale.

developers.apiDescription: Ku dhis isla REST API-ga uu app-ka temetro isticmaalo
developers.baseUrlDescription: Dhammaan endpoint-yadu waxay ku hoos jiraan asalkan (tusaale /api/patients)
developers.authDescription: Codsiyada waxay ku xaqiijiyaan cookie-ga fadhigaaga temetro. Token-yada gelitaanka shakhsi ee loo qaybiyay isticmaalka server-ku-server waa la qorsheeyay.
developers.tokensDescription: Token-yo cimri dheer leh oo loogu talagalay iskiriptooyinka iyo isku-xirka
developers.resourcesDescription: Halka aad wax badan ka baran karto
developers.resourcesBody: Tixraaca API — kaas oo daboolaya bukaannada, ballamaha, daawooyinka, hawlaha, fariimaha, dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo falanqaynta — wuxuu ku jiraa dukumeentiga mashruuca ee hoos yimaada docs/api. temetro waa ilo furan, sidaas darteed maareeyeyaasha waddada ee backend/src/routes ayaa ah tilmaanta rasmiga ah.

email.title: Bixiyaha iimaylka
email.description: Sida temetro u diro iimaylada xaqiijinta, dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta iyo casuumaadka. Kani waa deji guud oo deggaan.
email.apiKeySet: •••••••• (la kaydiyay — u daa banaan si aad u hayso)
email.apiKeyPlaceholder: Ku dheji furaha API ee bixiyahaaga
email.smtpHint: SMTP wuxuu isticmaalaa doorsoomayaasha deegaanka SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS ee serverka.
email.testSentBody: Waxaa la diray iimayl tijaabo ah {{to}}.

profile.clinicianIdDescription: Aqoonsigaaga dhakhtar ee gaarka ah, oo la isticmaalo marka la saxiixayo diiwaannada
profile.handleDescription: Waxaa loo isticmaalaa astaantaada dadweynaha iyo bogga bukaanka
profile.professionalLinksHint: Astaamaha diiwaanka ama hay'adaha oo loo isticmaalo xaqiijinta aqoonsigaaga. Weligaa bukaannada looma muujiyo.

language.title: Luqad
language.description: Luqadda uu wajiga temetro ku muuqdo qalabkan.
language.label: Luqadda muujinta
language.confirmBody: U beddel wajiga {{language}}? App-ku wuxuu qoraalkiisa ku soo celin doonaa luqadda cusub.

profile.patientNotificationsDescription: Iimaylada loo diro bukaannada oo ku saabsan diiwaannadooda, natiijooyinka, iyo ansixinta la sugayo
profile.accountNotificationsDescription: Ogeysiisyada laguu soo diro oo ku saabsan bukaannadaada iyo kooxda daryeelka
profile.featuresDescription: Maaree astaamaha alpha & beta ee akoonkaaga
profile.dangerZoneDescription: Ficillo aan dib loo celin karin oo akoonkaaga
profile.deleteAccountDescription: Si joogto ah u tirtir akoonkaaga temetro iyo furayaasha saxiixa ee maxalli ah lagu kaydiyay. Ficilkan dib looma celin karo.
profile.unsavedChanges: Waxaad haysataa isbeddello aan la kaydin

deleteDialog.title: Tirtir akoonkaaga?
deleteDialog.description: Tan si joogto ah ayay u tirtiraysaa akoonkaaga, kaaga saaraysaa rugahaaga, dibna looma celin karo.
deleteDialog.failed: Akoonka lama tirtiri karin. Hubi furahaaga sirta oo isku day mar kale.

network.title: Shabakadda Temetro
network.description: Gudbiyaha Shabakadda Temetro wuxuu u oggolaanayaa abaabulka boorsada bukaannada inay ku xidhaan rugtaada si ay u wadaagaan oo u ansixiyaan diiwaannada — sir gaba-gabo ah, iyadoo rugtaada lagu aqoonsado furaheeda saxiixa.
network.toggleDesc: Marka la shido, rugtan waxay ku xidhmaysaa gudbiyaha si aad u soo dejiso diiwaannada abaabulka bukaannada oo aad cusboonaysiin ugu dirto boorsadooda.
network.joinedBody: Abaabulka boorsada bukaannada hadda way ku xidhmi karaan rugtan.

signing.keyDescription: Isbeddel kasta oo aad ku sameyso diiwaanka bukaanka waxaa lagu saxiixaa furahan, si bukaannadu u hubiyaan inuu adiga kaa yimid ka hor inta aysan ansixin.
signing.rotateSuccessBody: Furaha Ed25519 cusub hadda wuu u firfircoon yahay rugtan.
signing.loadError: Furaha saxiixa lama soo dejin karin.
signing.loading: Furaha saxiixa waa la soo raraya…
signing.identityDescription: Furaha dadweynaha ee bukaannadu isticmaalaan si ay u xaqiijiyaan saxiixaadaada
signing.fingerprintDescription: Wadaag ama daabac faraha si bukaannadu ay isbeddelladaada ku aamini karaan
signing.signedRecordsDescription: Isbeddellada aad saxiixday ee sugaya ansixinta bukaanka
signing.howItWorksDescription: Habka ka dambeeya diiwaannada bukaanku ansixiyo

steps.signDesc: Wax-ka-beddel kasta oo aad ku sameyso diiwaanka bukaanka waxaa lagu saxiixaa furahaaga gaarka ah ka hor inta aan la qorin.
steps.approveDesc: Isbeddellada la saxiixay waxay sugayaan ilaa bukaanku ku aqbalo app-ka wehelka ah.
steps.verifyDesc: Faraha furahaaga dadweynaha wuxuu u ogolaadaa bukaannada iyo rugaha kale inay xaqiijiyaan in isbeddel dhab ahaan kaa yimid.

signing.backupDescription: Soo celi aqoonsigaaga saxiixa haddii aad lumiso qalabkan
signing.backupDesc: Dhoofi kayd shifran oo furahaaga saxiixa si aad ugu soo celiso qalab cusub.

availability.title: Helitaan
availability.description: Xakamee cida rugtaada gudaheeda isticmaali karta kaaliyaha AI. Marka la damiyo, wajiga AI kasta — Sheeko cusub, Falanqayn, iyo taariikhda sheekada — waa la qariyaa mana la gaari karo.
availability.enabledHint: Furaha weyn. Damintiisa waxay damisaa oo qarisaa AI-ga qof kasta oo rugta ku jira — oo ay ku jiraan milkiilayaasha iyo maamulayaasha.
availability.employeesOnlyHint: U hay AI-ga milkiilayaasha iyo maamulayaasha, laakiin ka qari shaqaalaha kale oo dhan.
availability.savedBody: Isbeddelku wuxuu khuseeyaa rugtaada oo dhan.
availability.readonlyEnabled: Kaaliyaha AI waa loo awoodsiiyay rugtaada.
availability.readonlyEmployeesOnly: Kaaliyaha AI waxaa lagu xaddiday milkiilayaasha iyo maamulayaasha.
availability.readonlyDisabled: Kaaliyaha AI waa loo damiyay rugtaada.

ai.modeDescription: Dooro sida temetro u socodsiiyo AI-ga. Furaha API ee daruuraha wuxuu xogta ka diraa kaabayaashaada; moodeel maxalli ah wax kastaa wuxuu ku hayaa mashiinkaaga.
ai.modeApiHint: Codsiyada waxay u socdaan bixiyahaaga aad dooratay. Aqoonsiyada bukaanka waxaa qariya Veil ka hor inta aysan bixin.
ai.modeLocalHint: Codsiyada waxay ku socdaan moodeel kaabayaashaada ah. Xog bukaan kama baxdo rugta.
ai.providerDescription: Furahaaga waa la shifraa marka la kaydiyo mana dib loo muujiyo. Waxaad kaydin kartaa fur bixiye kasta oo aad kala beddeli kartaa.
ai.apiKeyHint: Furaha waa la shifraa ka hor kaydinta waxaana loo isticmaalaa oo keliya wicitaanka bixiyaha.
ai.localDescription: Ku tilmaam temetro serverkaaga Ollama. Moodeelku wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa kaabayaashaada, sidaas darteed xog bukaan weligeed kama baxdo rugta.
ai.veilDescription: Veil wuxuu qariyaa macluumaadka bukaanka ka hor inta loo diro moodeel dibadeed, kadibna wuu ku soo celiyaa jawaabta.

veilLevels.full: Buuxa — magacyada, MRN-yada, dhakhaatiirta & qoraal xor ah
veilLevels.names: Magacyada oo keliya — aqoonsiyada tooska ah
veilLevels.off: Damin — dir xogta sida ay tahay (looma talinayo)

ai.veilApiNote: Veil wuxuu khuseeyaa codsi dibadeed kasta. Aqoonsiyada waxaa lagu beddelaa token-yo aan moodeelku weligiis arkin, dibna loo geliyaa ka hor intaadan akhrin jawaabta.
ai.veilLocalNote: Waxaad ku jirtaa habka maxalliga ah, sidaas darteed xog bukaan weligeed kama baxdo kaabayaashaada, Veilna looma baahna.
ai.unsavedChanges: Waxaad haysataa dejin AI oo aan la kaydin.
ai.saveFailedBody: Kaydinta dejinta AI waa fashilantay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
